root_cause: The pricing production verifier required Playwright body visibility before exercising any pricing interaction. Production route verification had already proven the page loaded with visible content, but the redundant body-state prerequisite timed out and prevented the authoritative lifecycle, plan, billing and English-route checks from running.
prevention: Pricing browser proof waits for DOM attachment and the pricing runtime readiness marker, then proves visibility through the actual controls and panels.
Do not use generic body visibility as a substitute for control-level visibility/clickability.
English proof must include a visible English Pricing text element, html lang=en, no Dutch pricing H1 and no language-failure banner.
Never force-click controls; normal clicks remain mandatory.

evidence.failure: Timeout waiting for locator('body') to be visible before pricing interaction proof.
